title: Quickstep Navigator: Empty Slate Tiles, First-Run Checklist & Contextual Tips
creator: Ava Martinez
description:
Objective: Design a compact, keyboard-first 'Quickstep Navigator' bundle for the Console first-run experience. Deliver a system of empty-slate tiles, a three-step first-run checklist panel, and persistent contextual tips (hover + keyboard tip variants) that scale across desktop/tablet/mobile.

Scope: produce Figma-ready artboards and exportable assets (SVG sprite, PNG snapshots, Lottie JSON for short hint micro-animations), microcopy variants (concise, friendly, formal), screenshot-ready frames for the release notes, and accessibility notes for WCAG AA. Include developer-ready CSS tokens and a small pattern library for reuse in the Console.

Why: current onboarding feels heavy and modal-heavy; Quickstep aims to reduce cognitive load and provide a low-friction path to first success for engineers and platform teams. The pattern must work for both self-serve signups and enterprise admin flows (with small copy/CTA swap).
acceptance_criteria: Empty-slate tile system: 4 variants (new project, import model, explore catalog, invite team) with desktop/tablet/mobile artboards exported
Checklist panel: three progressive steps implemented as non-blocking sidebar with 'mark done' & revert actions; copy variants approved by PM
Tooltips/tips: hover + keyboard-only hint states designed and exported as CSS variables and Lottie animation for the 'first token streamed' micro-hint
Dark-mode & high-contrast accessible: color tokens meet WCAG AA for text and icons across all tiles
Dev handoff: Figma tokens + SVG sprite + PNG exports in 1x/2x; annotated spec page with interaction states and animation timing
comments: 2026-03-01 - Ava Martinez: Kickoff — mapped existing onboarding flows and did a heuristic review. Key constraint: minimize modals; want persistent, dismissible guidance. Added initial artboard sketches to Figma.
2026-03-03 - Liam O'Connor: Review — prefer keyboard-first tips and single-line microcopy for engineers. Flagging potential engineering effort for Lottie (fallback to CSS animation).

2026-03-05 - Maya Patel (PM): Feedback — add enterprise copy variant that calls out 'SAML & VPC' instead of 'Invite team' for private deployments. Also request analytics hooks (which tiles clicked) for growth funnel team.
2026-03-08 - Liam O'Connor: Update — first pass of tiles complete in Figma, exported SVG sprite for icons; added popover timing spec (enter: 120ms, exit: 80ms, idle hint pulse: 2s interval).

2026-03-10 - Design Review — cross-functional sync: Dev (ENG-8182) estimates 3 points to implement CSS sprite + tooltip system, 5 points to add Lottie; decided to ship with CSS animation and add Lottie in a follow-up. Action: add fallback states in spec.
2026-03-12 - Ava Martinez: Updated assets — uploaded snapshot frames for release notes and added alternative microcopy options (concise/friendly/formal). QA checklist added to artifacts.
accessibility_considerations: All interactive tiles must be keyboard focusable with visible focus ring
Tooltips must be accessible via aria-describedby when visible and have role='tooltip' fallback
Ensure minimum contrast ratio of 4.5:1 for primary CTA text on tiles and 3:1 for large display copy per WCAG AA
export_spec: SVG sprite: single-file sprite.svg containing icons (optimized with SVGO)
PNG exports: 1x and 2x for desktop/tablet/mobile frames (sizes: 1440w, 1024w, 420w)
Lottie JSON: hint-pulse.json (max 120kb) + fallback CSS keyframes
screenshots_spec: Release note hero: 1280x720 PNG, white background, contextual console chrome cropped
Console guide embeds: 800x400 PNG with device frame and 2x retina export
Thumbnail sprite: 320x180 JPEG for marketing usage
animation_guidelines: Hint pulse: scale 1.0 -> 1.03 -> 1.0, opacity 1 -> 0.6 -> 1 over 1.6s, ease-in-out
Entrance: slide Y -6px -> 0 and fade 0 -> 1 over 160ms
Reduced-motion: disable scale and use opacity-only fade
Lottie fallback: set bodymovin autoplay=false for script-controlled trigger
implementation_notes: Provide CSS variables for spacing and color tokens in the spec page
Tooltip system should support two triggers: hover and keyboard focus; add data-tip-type attribute for analytics
Provide 'dismiss for 7 days' metadata hook in localStorage and corresponding analytics event 'quickstep.dismiss'
Enterprise flows: include boolean flag in payload to swap CTA microcopy (invite vs. configure network)
risks: Lottie assets increase bundle size; decided to ship CSS animation first
Possible copy overload for new users; will A/B test concise vs friendly variants via Experiment ENG-8207
Edge case: very small viewports may truncate tiles — add ellipsis and 'more' drilldown
